_meta.change: split the cogPG.PG125 whole-volume CGPG dump into per-work corpus files
_meta.plan_basis: cgpg_zerocredit_identification.json PG125 (its work ranges are Migne columns; the loci below follow the per-work evidence fields, which give the served locus spans)
_meta.shared_row_rule: a served row holding a work boundary is assigned to exactly one work, normally the one whose incipit the row carries; the plan records the decision as the ranges themselves
_meta.reversible: To revert: for every carved work file listed under 'works', drop its rows whose locus starts 'PG125.' (delete the file when it was 'created'), strip the 'PG125.' prefix from their loci, re-insert them and the archived 'dropped_duplicates' rows into data/corpus/cogPG.PG125.jsonl together with the residual rows, sorted by locus, and restore data/cgpg_works.json, data/tlg_crosswalk.json/.tsv, and data/corrections_log/provenance.json from the parent commit (or simply git revert the commit; old sha256 below verifies). Every moved row's text is byte-identical; only urn and locus changed.

works.title: Expositio in epistolam I ad Timotheum

incipit_checks.incipit: Ὑπόθεσις τῆς πρὸς Τμόθεον πρώτης Ἐπιστολῆς. Τῶν. τοῦ Παύου μαθητῶν ὁ Τιμόθεος ἦν, καὶ οΠνω τις εὐδόκιμος, καὶ τῷ Παύλῳ προστετηκὼς

works.evidence: Loci 12-51 (work ends at top of locus 51 before the 2 Tim title). Row 12 opens with the hypothesis of 1 Tim; commentary runs through 1 Tim 6:20-21 (κενοφωνίας/καινοφωνίας discussion) ending on locus 50-51. Theophylact of Ohrid is not in TLG-E canon (only Theophylactus Simocatta, tlg3130); no canon work points at MPG 125.
works.notes: shared boundary row 51 (1 Tim end + 2 Tim title) is assigned to the 2 Timothy work

works.title: In Acta apostolorum commentarius (first, longer text; catena compiled largely from Chrysostom; Theophylact attribution rejected)

incipit_checks.incipit: Πράξεις ἀποστόλων τὸ βιβλίον καλεῖται, ἐπειδὴ τὰς πράξεις ὁμοῦ τῶν ἀποστόλων περιέχει.

works.evidence: Loci 249 (mid-row, after a dedicatory epigram) to 431. Front matter: hypothesis (249-250, 'Ἀντιοχεὺς γὰρ οὗτος ὑπάρχων τὸ γένος' at 250), list of signs (251), 'Τὰ Κεφάλαια τῶν Πράξεων τῶν ἀγίων ἀποστόλων' (252-254), then a prologue explicitly headed 'Τοῦ ἐν ἀγίοις Πατρὸς ἡμῶν Ἰωάννου τοῦ Χρυσοστόμου ὑπόμνημα εἰς τὰς Πράξεις' with the incipit of Chrysostom In Acta hom. 1 ('Πολλοῖς τοῦτο τὸ βιβλίον...', cf. PG 60:13) at locus 255. Commentary organized by CAPUT (ΟΑΡΩΤ Ι = CAPUT I at 257) through Acts 28:29 at locus 431. Theophylact's authorship of the PG125 Acts material is generally rejected; content is catena/Chrysostom-derived.
